title: Sheep, shaders, and starting over - rebuilding my browser sheepdog sim
author: MattMaxBuilds
selftext:
I started Sheepdog Sim almost a year ago for a Three.js game jam. This was one of my first 3d games as before that I was making 2d games with pygame and vanilla js. AI-assisted development has been at the core of my workflows since the start. As the models got better, I began attempting more ambitious games like Sheepdog Sim. The art was very much early days prototyping from the sheep to the fences to the trees.

Over time, I started using things like glbs, bought a dog asset, and kept expanding the simulator. Multiplayer, a sandbox, pushing the number of sheep to the limit (hit a wall around 100k sheep on my machine), islands, different game modes, and the list goes on. Scope creep hit hard. These new shiny features were cool but not fun.

I did a WebGPU rebuild along the way, but I'd also ended up using React without React Three Fiber, with a weird custom framework that just made no sense to maintain. With the latest models and leaps in capability I decided to return to my roots by burning down the forest and getting back to herding.

This version uses R3F, TSL, and all the assets (except sounds) are authored in code. You can customize your flock and dog as well as name them. r/sheep gave me some good advice to add more variety to the flock and I am really happy with the new direction of the art style.

V3 is still early, but i think it is my best looking and best playing version so far.

you can play it here: [https://sheepdogsim.com](https://sheepdogsim.com)

it's also open sauce: [https://github.com/matthew-kissinger/sds](https://github.com/matthew-kissinger/sds)

comments.author: Ok_Constant257
comments.body: well made game, its very fluid and natural feeling. i played through twice but it didnt save my 2nd time. i like it, its just kinda boring, i dont really know what i would do to improve that tho

replies.author: MattMaxBuilds
replies.body: I have been mulling ways to make to more fun. Something along the lines of being able to grow your flock and maybe some idle game mode but it has been hard to figure out what that looks like to implement.

replies.author: PunkApps
replies.body:
Change locations. Add predator s?

Wolves, foxes, coyotes, pathers and bears?

replies.author: MattMaxBuilds
replies.body: Wolves and different scenes like an island were in the previous V2 version. The circular island with a pasture inside was exponentially more difficult to herd and the wolves made it even more stressful so when i add new scenes and predators back in the mix i ~want~ to make sure they are a positive addition and not just throwing slop at the wall to see what sticks.
